content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Bhubaneswar
content_sections.text: AIIMS Bhubaneswar, at Sijua, Post: Dumuduma, Bhubaneswar-751019, describes itself as a statutory body under the aegis of the Ministry of H & F.W., Govt. of India. This recruitment is for a research project in its Department of Pharmacology, funded by ICMR. The posts are on a temporary contract basis.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces 2 vacancies in total, one in each post. It prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Desirable: Research experience in molecular biology techniques and cell culture methods. Maximum age limit: 35 years. Desirable: Practical experience in blood collection (venepuncture), processing, labelling, storage and handling of biological specimens; operation and maintenance of basic laboratory instruments; and knowledge of laboratory safety and biomedical waste management. Maximum age limit: 28 years. The cut-off date for the age limit is the date of the interview. Age relaxation is admissible for SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates as per government rules; the notice prints no further detail. Candidates already in regular time scale service under any Government Department or Organisation are not eligible to apply. The prescribed qualification is the minimum, and possessing it does not entitle a candidate to selection. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Postgraduate Degree in Life Sciences or Pharmaceutical Sciences, including the integrated PG Degree.
10th+Diploma (MLT/DMLT) + Two years experience in relevant subject/field, Or, Three years graduate degree (B.Sc. MLT) in relevant subject / field + one year experience in relevant subject.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are printed as consolidated: Rs. 56,000 + 20% HRA for Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) and Rs. 18,000 + 20% HRA for Project Technical Support-I. The posts are filled purely on temporary contract appointment. The initial tenure is 11 months, which may be extended periodically up to a maximum of 36 months, based on satisfactory performance and the requirements of the project, subject to approval of the competent authority. Leave applies as per Funding Agency or institutional policy for contract staff of AIIMS Bhubaneswar. Provident Fund, Pension Scheme, Leave Travel Concession and Medical claim are not admissible. The contract can be terminated at any time with one month's notice on either side, or forthwith by paying a sum equal to one month's contractual amount.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Apply through the Google form for your post. Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical): https://forms.gle/5AoBfqKonA5ZnksF6 . Project Technical Support-I: https://forms.gle/AxaYm3LxJsUe717g6 . Submit before 24 November 2026. Late and incomplete applications, or applications not submitted through the Google form, will not be considered. Fill in the application form in the prescribed format printed in the notice. It asks for personal details, address, educational qualification, current activities, experience, two referees and details of desirable qualifications, and ends with a signed declaration. Appear for the walk-in interview (offline only) at the Dept. of Pharmacology, First floor, Academic Block, AIIMS, Bhubaneswar. Bring the duly filled application form, all original documents, one set of photocopies of educational qualification and experience certificates, and one passport-size photo. Contact address given in the notice: Prof. (Dr.) Rituparna Maiti, Department of Pharmacology, Room No. 118, First Floor Academic Block, AIIMS, Bhubaneswar – 751019. Email: [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: A scrutiny committee verifies documents on the same day, and eligible candidates are allowed to attend the offline interview. Depending on the number of applications, an MCQ test may be conducted as a screening test before the interview. The interview is held at AIIMS Bhubaneswar in offline mode only, and no TA/DA is paid for attending it. The notice does not give a reporting time. The decision of the competent authority on selection is final.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: one Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) and one Project Technical Support-I, in the Department of Pharmacology.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to apply through the Google form is 24 November 2026. Late and incomplete applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical)?
faq.answer: A Postgraduate Degree in Life Sciences or Pharmaceutical Sciences, including the integrated PG Degree. Research experience in molecular biology techniques and cell culture methods is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Project Technical Support-I?
faq.answer: 10th+Diploma (MLT/DMLT) + two years experience in relevant subject/field, or a three years graduate degree (B.Sc. MLT) in relevant subject/field + one year experience in relevant subject.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years for Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) and 28 years for Project Technical Support-I, counted on the date of the interview. SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates get relaxation as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) gets Rs. 56,000 + 20% HRA (consolidated); Project Technical Support-I gets Rs. 18,000 + 20% HRA (consolidated).

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply through the post-wise Google form by 24 November 2026, then attend the offline walk-in interview at the Dept. of Pharmacology, First floor, Academic Block, AIIMS, Bhubaneswar, with the filled application form, original documents, photocopies and one passport-size photo.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Documents are verified by a scrutiny committee on the interview day, followed by an offline interview. An MCQ screening test may be held before the interview, depending on the number of applications.

faq.question: Q9. When are the interviews?
faq.answer: The interview for Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) is on 27 November 2026, and for Project Technical Support-I on 28 November 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job, and for how long is the contract?
faq.answer: No, it is a purely temporary contract appointment. The initial tenure is 11 months, extendable up to a maximum of 36 months, and the appointee has no claim on a regular post.
